name: Mandarin Oriental, New York
insider_take: Soaring above Columbus Circle on floors 35–54, the Mandarin Oriental New York delivers jaw-dropping Central Park and Manhattan skyline views wrapped in legendary Asian-inspired luxury — a true New York icon.
whats_special: Sky-High Drama: The hotel lobby sits on the 35th floor, greeting guests with panoramic views of Central Park, the Hudson River, and the glittering Manhattan skyline from the moment you step off the elevator. World-Class Spa: The Mandarin Oriental Spa spans an entire floor and features 14 treatment rooms, a stunning pool with skyline views, and holistic wellness rituals rooted in ancient Asian traditions. Prime Location: Perched atop the Time Warner Center at Columbus Circle, guests are steps from Central Park, Lincoln Center, and some of NYC's finest dining and shopping.
pro_tip: Request a Central Park View room on a high floor for the most breathtaking vantage point — sunsets over the park from this elevation are absolutely unforgettable. Pair it with a cocktail at Lobby Lounge for the full effect.
dont_miss: Lobby Lounge Bar & Terrace: One of New York's most spectacular spots for afternoon tea or an evening cocktail, with floor-to-ceiling windows framing Central Park in all its glory. Central Park: Step outside and you're at the southeast corner of one of the world's greatest urban parks — perfect for a morning jog, a bike ride, or simply a leisurely stroll. Lincoln Center: Just minutes away, catch a world-class performance at one of the most prestigious performing arts venues on the planet.
pros: Stunning Central Park and Manhattan skyline views from high floors
Premium Columbus Circle location with luxury shopping access
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
cons: Busy Midtown location may not suit those seeking tranquility
